title: Could Black Holes Hold the Key to Reality? @jannalevinastro tells us more

author: StarTalk
description:
Janna Levin explores black holes… in theory. In the second installment of this series, Janna Levin takes us on a journey into the real and theoretical world of black holes. What qualifies a black hole? How does Hawking radiation support the preservation of information? Does everything get eaten by a black hole at some point? 

Timestamps: 
00:00 - Black Holes… In Theory
00:49 - Are Black Holes Fundamental? 
03:58 - Evaporation & Quantum Fluctuation
07:20 - Hawking Radiation
11:27 - The Information Loss Paradox
12:56 - The End of the Universe
14:53 - The Event Horizon
